pr_title: dumpling: fix tidb lock consistency and check tikv problem
pr_body:
<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?
 
Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/29411

Problem Summary:
1. dumpling may dump inconsistent data when dumping tidb using consistency lock but tidb `enable-table-lock` is false.
2. dumpling check whether tidb has tikv may face a privilege problem. Using `select @@tidb_config` can avoid this problem.

### What is changed and how it works?
Use `SELECT @@tidb_config` to solve these problems.

issue_context.title: [Dumpling] dumpling --consistency lock doesn't lock table as expected
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
1. Deploy tidb cluster, enable-table-lock not configured to true (by default), refer to: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/config/config.toml.example#L80-L81
2. Dumpling tidb, specifying consistency level as "--consistency lock"

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
We should check whether enable-table-lock is on before lock table. 
If enable-table-lock is not enabled, dumpling should fail directly? (to further determination)

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
When --consistency lock parameters provided, dumpling will lock table by run SQL "lock table xx read", but it doesn't actually lock table as expected if enable-table-lock is not enabled, the "locked" table can still be modified/deleted when dumpling lock it. It might result in dumpling failure.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
Release Version: v5.3.0-alpha-1248-g20023fe9e
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 20023fe9eaaef9a98990ce59d6409c28767d9788
Git Branch: master
UTC Build Time: 2021-10-28 11:18:05
GoVersion: go1.16.4
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false

review_comments: Is tidbConfig compatible across major versions? 🤔 Since we need to be compatible within at least 2 major versions.

> Is tidbConfig compatible across major versions? 🤔 Since we need to be compatible within at least 2 major versions.

`@@tidb_config` exists at least from v2.0.0, so this works in most existing tidb instances.

> AFAIK @@tidb_config isn't available in SEM 🤔

It doesn't matter, we just reject users to use lock consistency in that case. In most cases `snapshot` consistency is better.
if `CheckTiDBEnableTableLock` returns error, user can't continue dumping 🤔 Can we only check `CheckTiDBEnableTableLock` when needed?

This check will only run when we dump tidb tables with consistency lock. Because without `enable-table-lock` TiDB will return a successful result from `LOCK TABLES` but actually it doesn't have any effect, so we need to make sure this variable is set before we lock tables.
Oh I noticed the receiver is `ConsistencyLockDumpingTables`
